svg.title: The gradient is an average of error times feature
svg.desc: Three hand-drawn panels: eight points with red vertical residual segments dropping onto a fitted line, the mean-squared-error gradient derived in three badged steps ending in the highlighted phrase average of error times feature, and two contour plots contrasting a near-circular scaled loss surface where four green arrows walk to the minimum with a long thin unscaled ravine at condition number 5.642e10 where a red zig-zag path diverges.
svg.text: The gradient is an average of error times feature
square them so the signs cannot
cancel - that is the ONLY reason
one number per weight, and every one is a mean
normal equation: n.p^2 + p^3/3 flops, 8.p^2 bytes
10M rows, p=8: direct solve 0.03 s vs 2000 GD steps 0.65 s
...and if X'X is singular? -> ridge, M4
